turns.replyTail:
Happy Wax • AI Assistant

Read the warmer instructions first.


Place the silicone dish on top.

Do not add water or oil.


Plug it in, turn it on, and set the timer if your warmer has one.


Keep it on a safe, flat surface and don’t let the cord hang over an edge.
